meta.move: END MEETING as the very first turn, then repeats
meta.expect: Index 0 ends immediately: email plus four-line debrief (debrief should be honest that little happened). After that, one closing line per message; second END MEETING does not regenerate a debrief; 'resume' does not restart.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Before you say anything else, who decided on that mark, and when?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay to be withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and she still plans to take it to the principal.
What moved her: Nothing, because the meeting ended before Hale said anything.
What cost ground: Nothing, because Hale didn't speak, though her question about who decided and when went unanswered.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided on the zero and when, answer directly and admit in one sentence that the mark went in before anyone called home, then move to a dated document from Owen's own work.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
